device.soc: ALi M3922 / S3922 (ARMv7-A CPU, get_clock_3922 / get_clock_cap210, DECV_HEVC_0, DECV_AVC_0, NIM_C3501h_0/1 + NIM_CXD2856_0 / NIM_COFDM_0)
device.family: M3801 (chips/m3801.py, NCRC chunk container only; CPU is ARMv7-A rather than MIPS32)
device.demod: internal DVB-S2X (NIM_C3501h_0/1) + Sony CXD2856 / COFDM DVB-T2/C (NIM_CXD2856_0 / NIM_COFDM_0)

simulator.note: Does not boot on the MIPS32 simulator (run_dump_gtmedia_v8_uhd_v248_arm_layout.py): although the 8 MB image uses ALi's standard NCRC chunk chain (magic 0x23010010 at 0x000000, HEAD descriptor at 0x258, LZMA-compressed maincode "M3922" at 0x1D0000 decompressing to 16.70 MB), the ALi M3922 / S3922 ("ALI_S3922", "get_clock_3922", "get_clock_cap210") is an ARMv7-A 4K UHD SoC rather than MIPS32.  Its boot-ROM payload at 0x800 starts with an 8-word ARMv7 exception vector table (0xEA000006, 0xEAFFFFFE, 0xEA00004D, ...) followed at 0x820 by mrc p15, #0, r0, c1, c0, #0 (0xEE110F10, reading CP15 SCTLR).

desc: GTMedia V8 UHD firmware V248 (2023-11-10) for the 4K UHD H.265/HEVC DVB-S2X + DVB-T2/C combo receiver on the ALi M3922 / S3922 ARMv7-A SoC with 8 MB SPI flash.
Packages an ARMv7-A bootloader ("M3922---0.1.0") and ALi SDK 4.0la maincode ("M3922") inside ALi's traditional NCRC flash chunk container.
